en.question: Finance asks for a per-feature breakdown of Claude spend. What instrumentation gives you this?

options.text: The monthly invoice total, apportioned across features by headcount.
options.note: An aggregate total cannot be split by feature after the fact.

options.text: A count of API requests issued per feature, compared month over month.
options.note: Request counts ignore the huge variation in tokens per request.

options.text: An estimate derived from the average prompt length of each feature.
options.note: Estimates drift and miss cache effects entirely.

options.text: The usage block from every response, tagged with feature and model.

en.explanation: Each response reports the token counts that actually drove the charge, including cache reads and writes. Persisting that with a feature tag turns attribution into arithmetic rather than estimation.
